text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? A BBQ right now!?
I'm so jealous, jealous, jealous~~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's not a BBQ, it's an ex-per-i-ment in food magic!
What? You wanna be my assistant too?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, so we were just the assistants after all...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, who cares about the details! We get to eat meat, and that's what matters!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So true! Besides,
parties are way more fun with a big crowd♪
choice_data_list: (Uh-oh, I know where this is going...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pick me, pick me! We're coming too then!
We'll be your assistants! And grill the meat~~~~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'm on snack duty~~♡
I'll leave the rest to you guys~♪
choice_data_list: ...Well, guess it had to turn out like this.
...Well, it was bound to end up like this.

text_block_list.text:
Even so, since they're participating, I want them to have fun.
I'd like to support them as much as I can, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right! If you just stand there spacing out, the sun's gonna set! Let's get the ritual preparations done already!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, first we need to prepare the ingredients.
...The only issue is how to carry such a massive amount of them.
choice_data_list: Ah, shall I drive, then?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Really?
That would be a huge help♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What to get at the supermarket... meat, carrots, other veggies,
shrimp, yakisoba noodles, drinks... is that about it?
choice_data_list: Maybe some ice for heat control, too?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For adjusting the heat?
Not for drinking?
choice_data_list: When the fire's too strong, putting it on the charcoal works well.
When the fire's too strong, putting it on the charcoal works really well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You're pretty good at this!
...Alright, starting today, you're the Lead Assistant♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice going!
As expected of the genius Pandora-chan's Trainer♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this meat is suuuper tasty♡
Hey, hey, look at this~
choice_data_list: You want seconds, right? Just a sec—
You want seconds, right? Hold on a—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Cook☆Confect☆Cook!!
Meat! Become sweeter!
choice_data_list: Wait! Surely that much sugar is...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Hey, you put way too many bell peppers in! Take them out already—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Next up... Let's grill a few more carrots!
I want to eat those butter-flavored ones!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the one Trainer made for me!
That was so delicious!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll teach you the recipe.
Yeah! I'll give you the recipe.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Oh yeah, maybe I should use this chance
to slip some bell peppers onto Trainer's plate~?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh!? Holy crap! Fire! That's crazy!
Hey, seriously, it's blazing like mad over there!?
choice_data_list: Ah, ice! Try putting ice on the charcoal!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Mmmph!
Once we had somehow finished eating and were letting our food settle for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: Pandora, are you feeling a bit down?

text_block_list.text: Upon closer inspection, the plate on the desk was remarkably clean.
choice_data_list: Did we not have enough meat, by any chance?
Was that not enough meat for you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me?!
I am plenty satisfied as is!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: After all? Did somebody somewhere do something~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Foreeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeever!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: While doing all sorts of stuff, I ate a whole bunch!
choice_data_list: ...Are you mad?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I don't know!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Useless klutz.
Stupid!
Carrot-brain!

...I'm not entirely sure why,
but she seems mad at me.

After all the effort put into this BBQ,
I wanted it to end on a fun note, but...
choice_data_list: Treat them to a special BBQ menu
Invite to see fireworks

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What?
If it's roasted marshmallows, I already ate some earlier.
choice_data_list: Still, we haven't done the special arrangement yet, right?
Still, we haven't done the special arrangement yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...What's that?
A chocolate cookie?

Nodding along to Fusaichi Pandora's words,
I sandwich the perfectly toasted marshmallow
between two chocolate cookies.
choice_data_list: This is the only chocolate cookie left, so keep it a secret, yeah?
This is the only chocolate cookie left, so keep it a secret, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It's a secret...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Chomp!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
!!!!!!
What is this, it's sooooo goooood?!
choice_data_list: I know it's not much, but will you forgive me with this?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Oh, fine then♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If you promise to make this for me again next time,
I'll let you off the hook for today!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle☆
Fireworks, shine even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...I got my hopes up when you said fireworks.
They're just sparklers, and it's still broad daylight out..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's that?
Doesn't it look way bulkier than the others?
choice_data_list: It's the only one left, so I wanted to give it to Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......Hmm? Just one...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, your phone!
Take a video!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you take cute photos of me, okay?
...If you do, I'll forgive you for today♪
